# Broadway v1.3.0 - Table of Contents

Build concurrent and multi-stage data ingestion and data processing pipelines

- Examples
  - [Introduction](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/introduction.md)

- Internals
  - [Architecture](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/architecture.md)

## Modules

- [Broadway](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/Broadway.md): Broadway is a concurrent, multi-stage tool for building
data ingestion and data processing pipelines.
- [Broadway.Application](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/Broadway.Application.md)
- [Broadway.BatchInfo](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/Broadway.BatchInfo.md): A struct used to hold information about a generated batch.
- [Broadway.Message](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/Broadway.Message.md): This struct holds all information about a message.

- Acknowledgement
  - [Broadway.Acknowledger](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/Broadway.Acknowledger.md): A behaviour used to acknowledge that the received messages
were successfully processed or failed.
  - [Broadway.CallerAcknowledger](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/Broadway.CallerAcknowledger.md): A simple acknowledger that sends a message back to a caller.
  - [Broadway.NoopAcknowledger](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/Broadway.NoopAcknowledger.md): An acknowledger that does nothing.

- Producers
  - [Broadway.DummyProducer](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/Broadway.DummyProducer.md): A producer that does nothing, used mostly for testing.
  - [Broadway.Producer](https://broadway.hexdocs.pm/Broadway.Producer.md): A Broadway producer is a `GenStage` producer that emits
`Broadway.Message` structs as events.
